sources.content: Proposal BX-14: lifecycle rules for Bexlo buckets. Motivation: Bexlo users keep old object versions forever, and storage costs for the largest tenants grew 40 percent in 2025. Change: bucket owners can attach lifecycle rules that move objects to the cold tier after a set number of days and delete noncurrent versions after another. A rule matches objects by key prefix. Each bucket may hold at most 100 rules. Rules run once a day at 03:00 UTC.

Scope: this proposal covers versioned and unversioned buckets but not buckets under legal hold, which lifecycle rules never touch. The minimum age for a cold-tier move is 30 days. Deletions write an audit event to the bucket's access log. Rollout: the feature ships behind the flag bexlo.lifecycle, first to internal tenants in March, then to all tenants after four weeks with no data-loss incidents. Owners can turn the rules off per bucket at any time.
